events.title: Employee dies after found unresponsive on concrete floor
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Rock Of Ages Corporation. Graniteville, VT. At 2:30 p.m. on December 19, 2023, an employee was working for a stone mining and quarrying company when a coworker found him face down and unresponsive on the concrete floor under a drill table. The employee was working alone and was last known to have been operating a drill machine on a surface plate of granite.Medical records obtained following the investigation indicated that the employee had died from ventricular fibrillation due to obesity.

events.title: Employee is killed after falling from tree
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Savatree, Llc. Shelburne, VT. At 12:00 p.m. on October 31, 2023, an employee had climbed a poplar tree with a 21-inch base to cut the wire cable holding the three sections of the tree together. The employee cut a section of the wire cable from the tree with bolt cutters, when the base of the tree failed, causing two sections of the tree to fall. The employee was killed after falling approximately 25 feet and landing ontop of the tree.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by PIV that tips over
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Coon Construction Llc. Bennington, VT. At 3:00 p.m. on October 28, 2023, an employee working for a home builder was moving a JLG Telehandler powered industrial vehicle with a Tritan work platform attached when the PIV tipped over. The employee sustained multiple blunt force trauma and died.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by plywood
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Pc Construction Company. South Burlington, VT. At 7:30 a.m. on September 19, 2023, Employee #1 was spotting a powered industrial truck with a load of OSB plywood. The unsecured OSB plywood fell from the forks of the powered industrial truck onto Employee #1. Employee #1 sufferedcrushing and lung puncture injuries, resulting in a fatality.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by machine
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bellavance Trucking, Inc. Barre, VT. At 1:10 p.m. on August 8, 2023, an employee was unhooking the rigging of a machine that was loaded on his truck when a sling caught a bolt and tipped the machine over onto the employee and crushed him to death.

events.title: Employee is killed when electrocuted and falls to ground lev…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: C&V Contracting. West Burke, VT. At 11:15 a.m. on August 6, 2023, Employee #1, while sitting in proximity to the roof peak, was attempting to lift a roof hook ladder to install it on the opposing roof slope. Employee #1, while moving the aluminum roof hook ladder, came within the approach distance of the overhead single phase distribution power line. Employee #1 was electrocuted and fell to the ground level below. Employee #1 was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when attacked by client with axe and knif…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Groundworks Collaborative, Inc. Brattleboro, VT. At 9:30 a.m. on April 3, 2023, an employee was performing administrative tasks, when she was called into the living area to speak to a client who had requested to speak to her. The client assaulted the employee with an axe and a knife, striking her multiple times, resulting in a fatality. The employee sustained cuts, lacerations, and blunt force trauma.

events.title: Employee dies after suffering traumatic brain injury in fall…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Sit And Sleep Shop, Inc. Saint Albans, VT. At 9:30 a.m. on August 19, 2022, an employee was standing in the rear of a 20-foot box truck as the truck was moving with the overhead door open. The employee fell out of rear of box truck, striking his head on the pavement. The employee suffered a traumatic brain injury and died nine days later.

events.title: Employee falls from ladder while measuring stringers, later…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: B & R Electric, Inc. Shelburne, VT. At 8:30 a.m. on June 22, 2022, an employee was working from a 12-foot A-frame ladder taking measurments for stair stringers. The employee fell from the ladder and struck the concrete floor below. The employee incurred blunt force trauma to the left side of his head and his left hip. The employee lost consciousness and never regained consciousness. On July 1, 2022, the employee died.

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed between two dumpsters
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Casella Waste Management, Inc. Addison, VT. At 07:00 p.m. on August 05, 2021, an employee was loading a dumpsters onto a flatbed truck. While attempting to load a second dumpster, the first dumpster on the raised bed of the truck broke free and trapped the employee between the two.The cause of death was determined to be asphyxia and a crushed chest.

events.title: Employee falls off ladder and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Goulet & Son, Llc. Underhill, VT. At 9:06 a.m. on June 28, 2021, an employee attempted to climb down a forty-foot extension ladder carrying two one-gallon paint cans. While descending, the employee fell backwards at approximately thirty feet and was killed by blunt force trauma to the torso.

events.title: Employee is killed after being caught between vehicle and po…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Special Services Transportation Agency, Inc. Colchester, VT. At 1:42 p.m. on September 14, 2020, an employee was trying to unload two clients from his vehicle when he failed to put the vehicle in park. As the vehicle rolled backwards, the employee tried to physically stop it with body turning thesteering wheel through the driver side window. As vehicle turned the employee lost his footing and was crushed between a telephone pole and the vehicle killing him.

events.title: Employee is struck and killed by front-end loader
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Pleasant Valley Farms Of Berkshire, Llc. Richford, VT. events.title: Employee Is Killed When Trailer Tires Strike And Run Over He…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Vermont Natural Ag Products, Inc. Brandon, VT. At approximately 11:00 a.m. on September 21, 2017, Employee #1 was laying on hisback under an equipment trailer of a dump truck and draining the air tank to release the brakes on the trailer. As he drained the air tank, one of the other two coworkers entered the dump truck cab and drove the truck away, thinking the trailer had been unhitched. The trailer tires struck and ran over his head, causing crushing head injuries, killing him.

events.title: Employee is killed when roof collapses
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: All Industrial Services, Inc. Brattleboro, VT. The employee was burning the second section of the water tank roof and the entire roof collapsed taking the employee with it to the ground. The employee died on September 22, 2016 fromlacerations to the back of the head, broken neck, and broken back.

events.title: Employee is struck and killed by truck
